newsitem.title: USA: Circon says suitor should end tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Circon says suitor should end tender offer.

text.p: Circon Corp urged U.S. Surgical to end its $17 per share tender offer for the shares of Circon after U.S. Surgical on Friday extended its bid for the maker of medical instruments.
"I strongly encourage U.S. Surgical to end this exercise in futility," Richard A. Auhll, Circon chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
U.S. Surgical launched its bid for Circon in August, but has been unable to complete the acquisition.
In December, Circon rejected the proposed bid because its board believed the offer was inadequate.
